exceptions.justification: Provides the immutable raw-artifact and point-in-time object substrate used by the G0 data-truth persistence implementation.
Provides durable monotonic collector checkpoints and committed continuity watermarks.
Provides recorded-gap planning and non-backdating bounded recovery for collector continuity.

Exports the API application wiring around the requirement-mapped MCP surface modules.

Wires personal bearer authentication into the MCP request boundary.
Builds the per-client authorization context re-evaluated by MCP tools and resources.
